claims.statement: The lab converts release criteria into deterministic evaluation evidence.
The complete synthetic trial runs offline without a model judge.
Human annotations are recorded separately from automated evidence.
Human approval cannot reopen an automated safety failure.
Two external annotation systems were screened and rejected with traceable metadata.
A synthetic safety requirement is linked to implementation and regression evidence.
Synthetic, offline and human-authority boundaries are explicit.

boundaries: Synthetic evaluation runs and reviewer annotations only; no production accuracy or adoption claim.
Phrase checks are deterministic contract checks, not semantic truth or complete safety moderation.
A real pilot requires accountable reviewers, authenticated storage, privacy review and an approved adjudication process.
